name: Daily stock analysis report: computed indicators, AI news sentiment & crypto (free APIs)

parameters.content:
## Daily stock analysis report: computed indicators, AI news sentiment & crypto — on free APIs

### How it works

Every morning this workflow builds a professional market brief for your watchlist and delivers it as a polished HTML email plus a Telegram digest — built entirely on free data.

For every ticker it fetches 250 days of prices and **computes the indicators deterministically in code** — SMA 20/50/200, EMA 12/26, RSI-14 (Wilder), MACD(12,26,9), Bollinger(20,2), **ATR-14 with a suggested stop level (close − 2×ATR)**, 52-week range position, up/down streaks and 20-day volatility. No AI guessing at math, no chart-screenshot tricks: the numbers match your charting platform.

It then reads each ticker's latest headlines from Google News (no key needed), has AI score the news sentiment with a strict schema, and blends trend, momentum, sentiment and volatility into a **0–100 composite score with a BUY / HOLD / AVOID verdict** and the top reasons. Scores are saved to Google Sheets, so every report shows the day-over-day delta and flags **signal flips** — golden/death crosses, MACD crosses, RSI recoveries, fresh 52-week highs and lows, 5-day streaks, verdict changes. A crypto section (keyless CoinGecko) and an AI executive summary top it off.

Data plumbing: one free Twelve Data key (800 credits/day — a 20-ticker daily report uses ~20), Google News RSS and CoinGecko without any key, and your own OpenAI-compatible key for the AI steps. The workflow paces itself to respect the free rate limits, and it is built to always deliver: a mistyped symbol or an API hiccup shows up as a flagged “data unavailable” card while the rest of the brief arrives on time.

### Setup steps

Takes ≈15 minutes.

- Create a free Twelve Data account (no card) and replace `YOUR_TWELVEDATA_KEY` in **Fetch 250 Days of Prices**.
- Connect an OpenAI (or compatible) credential in **Market AI Model**.
- Open **Edit Your Watchlist** and set your tickers, cryptos and the email address the report goes to.
- Create a Google Sheet with columns `Date, Symbol, Score, Verdict` and select it in **Read the Score History From Google Sheets** and **Save Today's Scores to Google Sheets**.
- Connect Gmail in **Email the Report via Gmail**. For Telegram: create a bot with @BotFather, add its credential in **Send the Telegram Digest** and set your chat id.
- Click **Run a Test Report Now** to get your first brief immediately, then activate the workflow for the daily schedule.

### Customization

- **Schedule:** the default is every morning at 07:00 — change it in **Run Every Morning**. Duplicate the workflow with a tighter watchlist for an intraday version.
- **Scoring weights:** trend 35, momentum 30, sentiment 25, volatility 10 — all in one commented block of **Assemble the Ticker Scorecard**. Make it match your own strategy.
- **More tickers:** Twelve Data's free tier comfortably covers ~25/day with news; the pacing node already handles the 8-requests-per-minute limit.
- **Forex & ETFs:** Twelve Data serves them on the same endpoint — add `EUR/USD` or `SPY` to the watchlist as-is.
- **Alert-only mode:** the Telegram digest already leads with signal flips; delete the Gmail node if you only want flip alerts on your phone.
- **Stop distance:** the suggested stop is close − 2×ATR-14 — a common swing-trade default. Change the multiplier in **Compute the Technical Indicators** to match your risk tolerance.

*Educational information only — not investment advice.*

## Run it

Runs on the morning schedule, or instantly via the manual trigger. The watchlist node is the only place you configure tickers, cryptos and the report email.

## Load history and loop

Reads earlier scores from Google Sheets (so the report can show day-over-day deltas), then processes the watchlist one ticker at a time.

## Prices and real indicator math

250 daily bars from Twelve Data's free tier, then every indicator is computed deterministically in code — Wilder RSI, MACD, SMA/EMA, Bollinger, 52-week position, volatility — so the numbers match your charting platform.

## News sentiment with AI

Latest headlines per ticker from Google News (no key), scored by AI into a strict schema: sentiment −1…+1 plus the catalyst. No headlines → neutral, never invented.

## Score and pace

Blends trend, momentum, sentiment and volatility into a 0–100 composite with a BUY / HOLD / AVOID verdict and the top reasons, then waits to respect the free API's rate limit before the next ticker.

## Rank, detect flips, persist

Ranks the watchlist, compares against yesterday's saved scores to surface deltas and signal flips, and appends today's scores back to Google Sheets.

## Crypto and executive summary

A keyless CoinGecko call adds your crypto watchlist, then AI writes a short executive summary of the whole brief — top pick, biggest risk, notable flips.

## Deliver

A responsive HTML email with ranked table, per-ticker cards and inline sparklines (no external images), plus a compact Telegram digest that leads with signal flips.

messageValues.message: You write the executive summary at the top of a daily market brief. 3-4 plain-language sentences, no hype, no advice-giving verbs (say "scores highest", not "buy"): name the strongest and weakest ticker with the reason, call out the most significant signal flip or alert if any, and one line on crypto if present. Output plain text only.
